name: Naveen John
tagline: I build the data and ML systems behind micro-mobility safety research — camera–LiDAR sensor fusion, multi-modal ETL, and the backend services that put derived ride features in researchers' hands.

bullets.text: Design Python ETL pipelines that ingest, time-synchronize, and join 3 data modalities — sensor telemetry, ride video, and tabular trip logs — into one curated store.
Build backend REST services over PostgreSQL exposing derived ride features to analytics dashboards.
bullets.metric: replacing ad-hoc SQL pulls for 7 research teams across 10+ projects and halving average query turnaround

bullets.text: Instrument pipelines with schema validation, freshness checks, and alerting so data-quality defects surface before ingest rather than mid-study.
bullets.metric: across 3 stages, saving ~6 hrs/week of manual troubleshooting

bullets.text: Built a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline over 10,000 electronic health records, serving 2 LLMs (GPT-4.1, DeepSeek v3.1) through Azure AI Foundry to recommend the most frequent hospital procedures from a patient's demographics and medical history.

Designed an LLM evaluation framework scoring 1,000 responses on semantic similarity to known procedures, surfacing accuracy gaps of up to 9% across gender, race, ethnicity, and age — and showing those gaps shift when the models recommend five procedures instead of three.
First-authored Evaluating Bias in LLMs' Responses to Patient-Oriented Tasks with Dr. Ke Yang (UTSA College of AI, Cyber, and Computing), submitted to AIM 2026.
Enhanced backend integrations between Salesforce (Apex, SOQL), Java/Python services, and relational databases for an enterprise client.
bullets.metric: shipping into shared codebases owned by 5 teams

bullets.text: Diagnosed production incidents through logs, SQL queries, and dependency traces over 16 months with root-cause documentation and regression tests on every fix.
Partnered with product owners to scope and automate recurring workflows, reducing repeat incidents and removing standing manual effort.
bullets.metric: reducing repeat incidents by 90% and removing ~48 hrs/month of manual effort
